newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal sees av '97 inflation below 2.1 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal sees av '97 inflation below 2.1 pct-paper.

text.p: The Portuguese government forecasts December average annual inflation below 2.1 percent, under the government's official target between 2.25 and 2.50 percent, Diario Economico newspaper reported.
It quoted a source in the prime minister's office as saying the most pessimistic scenario forecasts average annual inflation of 2.1 percent in December 1997, down from 3.1 percent the year before.
Government spokesmen were not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
June average annual inflation, the latest month for which figures are available, stood at 2.9 percent. Year-on-year June inflation was 1.8 percent and the monthly change was a 0.3-percent drop.
